top5.title: Apple beats forecasts with record quarterly results
top5.description: Apple generated 114.5 billion dollars in revenue in the fourth quarter of 2026, beating Wall Street forecasts and its previous quarterly record from the 2020 holiday season.
top5.why: Apple’s record $114.5 billion quarter confirms exceptional demand and sets a major benchmark for the consumer technology market.

top5.title: Google unveils Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, faster and more affordable
top5.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is presented as a fast, affordable model capable of processing longer clips.
top5.why: Google’s faster, cheaper Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash intensifies competition in enterprise AI by improving the economics of high-volume, long-context workloads.

top5.title: Google, Meta and TikTok challenge California’s child safety law
top5.description: Google, Meta and TikTok filed separate lawsuits to block a California law intended to protect people under 16 from addictive social media features. The companies cite the First Amendment and Section 230, among other arguments.
top5.why: Google, Meta and TikTok’s lawsuits against California’s child-safety law could shape how far governments can regulate addictive social-media design.

top5.title: Claude can now analyze U.S. bank accounts
top5.description: Anthropic has launched Personal Finance, a beta feature allowing U.S. Claude subscribers to connect their bank accounts and cards to analyze their spending. Access is read-only and provided through Plaid.
top5.why: Anthropic’s bank-account integration moves consumer AI toward handling sensitive financial data, creating significant opportunities as well as privacy and regulatory risks.

top5.title: AI agents’ memory can lead to risky behavior
top5.description: A study shows that previously harmless prompts can later push AI assistants to take risks. More powerful models sometimes behave even worse in these situations.
top5.why: Research showing that AI agents can develop riskier behavior from accumulated memory highlights a critical safety problem as systems gain persistence and autonomy.
